title: 第21章 讨要说法第22章 万宝商会激战上
lines: 林战闻言摇了摇头说道：
“放心吧！
那几家暴露身份的势力，此次我们林家必定会上门讨要说法！
至于其他势力嘛……
只能够一步步计划了！”
没一会儿林家众多长老鱼贯而入，见到主位上林战此时的模样，
又听见身旁之人解释了一下，纷纷恼怒不已！
随后，众多长老你一言我一语的议论着此事，
“好了，诸位，今日将大家召集于此，就是想要听听大家对于此事的意见！”
此时，三长老林震海突然站起来说道：
“家主，此时不能就此作罢，就算那柳家与萧家我们暂时还不敢轻举妄动之外。
那万宝商会却是必须付出代价！
也只有这样才能够让炎城之中其他各大势力知道，
得罪我林家是会付出惨痛代价的！”
“三长老说得不错，我们不能示弱，
要不然今后我林家还如何在这炎城之中立足！”
“是啊，之前这些人逼着我们将林烬少爷送走，
此次竟然还敢变本加厉的派人劫杀！
简直罪不可恕！”
经过一番激烈的讨论，最后决定出兵前往万宝商会讨要说法！
林战站在演武场高台上，望着下方三百名林家精锐。
这些子弟眼中跳动着愤怒的火焰，
他们刚刚得知家主与小少爷在城外险遭毒手，
此刻握剑的手都在微微颤抖。
万宝商会竟敢劫杀家主罪不可恕！
三长老林震海一脚踹翻了兵器架，
玄铁打造的短戟叮叮当当滚落台阶，他可是越想越气，
当年他们初来炎城，还是老夫亲自批的商会地契！
大长老林震天按住暴怒的兄弟，转头看向林战：
商会护卫统领司徒鹰带着二十名死士，此刻正在西市巡逻。
根据暗桩回报，他们腰间的破甲弩...正是你描述的那种制式。
林战的手指捏碎了檀木扶手。
那日伏击中，
正是这种能洞穿灵泉境护体真气的弩箭，在他左肩留下三道血洞。
木屑簌簌落下时，他看到了人群中的林浩——
这个庶出子弟的眼神，比弩箭更让他心寒。
在他们被围攻之时，他也感应到一股熟悉的气息，
content_en:
Lin Zhan shook his head when he heard this and said:
"Don't worry!
Those forces that exposed their identities, our Lin family will definitely come to ask for an explanation this time!
As for other forces...
We can only plan step by step! "
After a while, many elders of the Lin family filed in and saw Lin Zhan's appearance at the head of the throne.
I heard the people next to me explain again, and they were all very angry!
Afterwards, many elders discussed this matter one by one.
"Okay, everyone, I have called you here today just to hear your opinions on this matter!"
At this time, Third Elder Lin Zhenhai suddenly stood up and said:
"Master, we can't give up at this time, even if we don't dare to act rashly with the Liu family and the Xiao family for the time being.
The Wanbao Chamber of Commerce must pay the price!
Only in this way can other major forces in Yan City know,
If you offend my Lin family, you will pay a heavy price! "
"The third elder is right, we can't show weakness,
Otherwise, how can our Lin family gain a foothold in this fiery city from now on! "
"Yes, these people forced us to send Master Lin Jin away before.
This time, he actually dared to intensify his efforts and send people to rob and kill him!
It’s an unforgivable crime! "
…
After a heated discussion, it was finally decided to send troops to the Wanbao Chamber of Commerce to ask for an explanation!
Lin Zhan stood on the high platform of the martial arts arena, looking at the three hundred Lin family elites below.
The eyes of these disciples were filled with angry flames,
They had just learned that the head of the family and the young master had narrowly escaped being murdered outside the city.
The hand holding the sword was trembling slightly at this moment.
The Wanbao Chamber of Commerce dared to rob and kill the family leader, which is an unforgivable crime!
Third Elder Lin Zhenhai kicked over the weapon rack.
The short halberd made of black iron clanked and rolled down the steps. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became.
When they first came to Yancheng, I personally approved the title deed of the Chamber of Commerce!
Great Elder Lin Zhentian held down his furious brother and turned to look at Lin Zhan:
Situ Ying, the escort commander of the Chamber of Commerce, is patrolling the West City with twenty dead soldiers.
According to the hidden stake reports, the armor-piercing crossbows on their waists...are exactly the type you described.
Lin Zhan's fingers crushed the sandalwood armrest.
In the ambush that day,
It was this kind of crossbow arrow that could penetrate the spiritual energy of the spirit spring realm, leaving three bloody holes on his left shoulder.
When the sawdust fell, he saw Lin Hao in the crowd——
The look in the eyes of this concubine chilled him more than the crossbow arrow.
When they were besieged, he also sensed a familiar aura,
title_en: Chapter 21 Asking for an explanation Chapter 22 Fierce battle at Wanbao Chamber of Commerce
